description: This Java class 'Configuration' represents an immutable configuration setup for an IDE or build system. It handles directory traversal to identify source roots, jar files, and excluded directories within a project, reading exclude patterns from configuration files, and detecting source roots based on Java package structures.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating project source roots, jar files, excluded directories, and related configuration logic.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration by traversing directory tree and reading exclude patterns.

methods.name: readExcludes
methods.description: Reads exclude patterns from global, vendor, and local exclude files.

methods.name: readVendorExcludes
methods.description: Reads vendor-specific exclude patterns from vendor directories.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories to identify source roots, jar files, and excluded directories.

methods.name: rootOf
methods.description: Determines the source root directory of a given Java file based on its package declaration.

methods.name: parsePackageName
methods.description: Extracts package name from a Java source file.

methods.name: excludesUnderSourceRoots
methods.description: Returns excluded directories that are under the identified source roots.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads a file of regex patterns and compiles them into pattern objects.
